tasks.label: SpindiSync: Test-Markdown erstellen
args: $pagesDir = Join-Path $env:SPINDISYNC_SOURCE_DIR 'pages'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $pagesDir | Out-Null; $content = '# SpindiSync-Test' + [Environment]::NewLine + [Environment]::NewLine + 'Diese Datei dient zum Testen des SpindiSync-Plugins.'; Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $pagesDir 'SpindiSync-Test.md') -Value $content -Encoding utf8
